baseline_models.focus_anchor: The linked construction جند لكم ينصركم من دون الرحمن asks for an owned force that can produce aid independently of al-Rahman.
baseline_models.mechanism: جند supplies a mutually supporting collective, ينصركم assigns that collective the function of aiding and making its clients prevail, and من دون marks it as an alternative source. The closing restriction diagnoses the proposed independence as deception rather than as a merely weak military estimate.

activation_trace.role: A mutually supporting host supplies the candidate collective and makes its claimed solidarity functional as protection.
Aid that brings victory states the exact performance demanded of the candidate host.
Otherness turns ordinary means into a rival source imagined apart from al-Rahman.
Merciful beneficence is the source against which the alleged independent protection is tested.
Blocking the truth explains why the failed alternative can still be asserted.
A lure that shines without holding makes the imagined force persuasive but non-performing.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply denies that another army can defeat God.
changed_reading.after: The ayah demands that the addressees identify the force they treat as theirs, specify how it could independently make them prevail, and confront that the alleged chain of support is only a persuasive appearance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence الكافرون إلا في غرور follows the challenge to identify a protecting جند.
baseline_models.mechanism: The supposed protective collective doubles as a social facade: covering suppresses recognition of dependence, while conspicuous brightness and deceptive shine make solidarity look self-sufficient. The restriction في غرور locates the group inside that appearance rather than merely saying that it holds one mistaken proposition.

activation_trace.role: The gathered host provides the visible social body whose cohesion can be mistaken for autonomous security.
Covering supplies the facade's concealment of the support on which it actually depends.
A conspicuous white blaze supplies the eye-catching front of the protective display.
Shine without stability converts the visible front into a deceptive assurance.
The facade works by presenting a dependent collective as an other source.

changed_reading.before: غرور is a generic mental error appended to the military question.
changed_reading.after: غرور is the inhabited facade generated when a visible coalition covers its dependence and advertises itself as independently protective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus noun جند carries a branch image of rough stony ground, beside دون as what is lower or short of the goal.
baseline_models.mechanism: A material branch permits the candidate 'army' to be imagined as defensive substrate rather than personnel: hard ground, stone, and low position seem to furnish a bastion. Covering and deceptive display then explain how a created surface is promoted into an ultimate support.

activation_trace.role: Rough stony ground materializes the army as terrain or fortifying substrate.
What lies lower and falls short places the supposed defense beneath its claimed ultimate function.
A covering layer lets the supporting surface conceal its own contingency.
Apparent solidity that does not hold supplies the false confidence placed in the substrate.

changed_reading.before: جند can only denote armed persons.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, جند also activates the stony ground or fortifying material treated as an impersonal army underfoot, even though it remains short of independent protection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ينصركم, من دون الرحمن, and في غرور combine aid, beneficence, and uncertain outcome in the focus ayah.
baseline_models.mechanism: Aid can arrive as a gift, but treating a received benefit as an owned guarantor converts mercy into a hazardous promise. The candidate lies below the needed end and its outcome cannot be secured, so the closing غرور diagnoses unbacked reliance.

activation_trace.role: Aid as a gift makes protection a received benefit rather than an asset owned by its beneficiary.
Merciful beneficence supplies the true giver relation hidden by the claimed guarantee.
Falling short of the goal marks the alternative as unable to underwrite the promised outcome.
Hazard and ignorance of the outcome characterize reliance on an unbacked protector.

changed_reading.before: The error is overestimating military strength.
changed_reading.after: The error is treating a contingent gift of support as an enforceable guarantee from a source that cannot secure the outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening assignment of ownership, command, and effective capacity to one hand turns لكم in the focus into the contested term. A host may be socially 'yours', but its capacity to act is not an independently owned command chain.

activation_trace.role: The owning hand supplies ultimate possession and contests the proprietary force implied by لكم.
Sovereign command places every subordinate force inside a prior authority structure.
Effective capacity that reaches action supplies the criterion the alleged army cannot possess independently.
The focus host is the subordinate collective whose apparent ownership is being tested.
Actual aid is the performance that requires capacity, ownership, and command to align.

structural_cues: The surah opens with بيده الملك and closes the focus challenge around the possessive لكم.
The focus interrogative asks for a demonstrable agent, not merely an abstract belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies owning hand, sovereignty, effective capacity, and an alleged host 'for you'; I infer that independent rescue requires an independent command chain. A live alternative is that the verse denies only ultimate autonomy while allowing armies as subordinate means.

changed_reading.before: No rival army is strong enough.
changed_reading.after: No collective can be both owned by the addressees and independently effective, because its possession, command, and capacity already sit within the sovereignty named at the opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated looking functions as a stress test for the protective facade. What first shines or covers is subjected to returned sight; the branch of حسر as stripping a cover makes exhaustion also an exposure event, leaving the imagined independent support without its visual casing.

activation_trace.role: Repeated visual perception supplies the inspection applied to an attractive but unstable appearance.
Returning the gaze converts a first impression into a repeated test.
Eyesight is the instrument whose result contests the shining front of غرور.
Removal of a covering supplies the revealing result of the inspection, alongside the surface sense of fatigue.
Covering is the concealed dependence that repeated inspection strips away.
Deceptive shine supplies the first impression that fails the test.

structural_cues: The earlier double imperative to return the gaze establishes repeated inspection as a surah-level procedure.
The focus closes with a state of being inside غرور rather than with evidence for the alleged army.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated sight, return, cover removal, focus covering, and deceptive shine; I infer that the earlier inspection procedure can be applied to the later security claim. Alternatively, 67:3-4 may remain limited to inspecting creation and only analogically illuminate the focus claim.

changed_reading.before: The coalition's facade is simply pronounced false.
changed_reading.after: The coalition's facade is a testable appearance: return the gaze until its covering is stripped and no independently sustaining force can be seen.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ground is first made tractable, then can sink and wave, while a stone-bearing wind can be sent from above. This activates the stony-ground branch of جند as an environmental defense whose allegiance reverses: the substrate serves only while made serviceable and can become the medium of threat.

activation_trace.role: Soft productive earth supplies the normally supportive substrate on which ordinary security depends.
Making difficult terrain tractable marks its usefulness as conferred rather than intrinsic.
Earth sinking removes the very platform treated as a defensive constant.
Waving motion turns apparently solid ground into an unstable actor.
A stone-bearing wind mobilizes defensive material as an incoming force.
Rough stony ground anchors the focus army in the same material field as earth and stone.

structural_cues: Ayat 67:15-17 immediately prepare the focus by alternating usable earth, collapsing earth, and weaponized stone-bearing air.
The focus follows these environmental reversals before naming a جند.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tractable earth, subsidence, waving, stone-bearing wind, and a stony-ground branch for جند; I infer that environmental affordances can function as an impersonal army and can reverse role. Alternatively, جند may remain strictly social while the terrain sequence only demonstrates the army's vulnerability.

changed_reading.before: The possible protector is a human army standing on stable ground.
changed_reading.after: The ground and stones themselves can act like support or assault, so even the army's platform is a conferred, reversible force rather than an independent bastion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding birds present a visible formation: light bodies spread in ranks and fold, yet their continued suspension is explicitly held by al-Rahman. The focus army is therefore reread through maintained formation; a rank is not an autonomous power merely because it looks coordinated.

activation_trace.role: Light flying bodies supply the visible collective immediately before the army challenge.
Alignment on an even line gives the birds an army-like ranked appearance.
Folding after spreading makes the formation dynamic rather than self-fixed.
Holding and restraining identifies the sustaining action beneath the visible formation.
Merciful beneficence is explicitly named as the holder of the ranked bodies.
The mutually supporting host is reread as another coordinated formation requiring maintenance.
The demand for effective aid distinguishes visible ranking from power to preserve or prevail.

structural_cues: 67:19 is the immediate antecedent and ends ما يمسكهن إلا الرحمن before 67:20 asks who can help من دون الرحمن.
The two adjacent ayat pair an exclusive sustaining clause with an interrogative challenge to an alternative force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ranked birds, folding, holding by al-Rahman, and a mutually supporting host; I infer that the bird formation is a concrete demonstration that coordination does not entail autonomy. Alternatively, the birds may illustrate divine power generally without serving as an army analogue.

changed_reading.before: An organized rank is evidence of a force capable of helping its owners.
changed_reading.after: The immediately displayed ranks are themselves held in being, so visible coordination cannot establish an autonomous army or an independent capacity to rescue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the same 'who is this' challenge but substitutes provision for military aid. The رزق inventory explicitly includes soldiers' provisions, so the army's efficacy moves from battlefield action to its supply line; withholding supply disables the force before combat.

activation_trace.role: Soldiers' provisions connect sustenance directly to the maintenance of a جند.
Apportioned giving makes the supply on which the alleged force depends a received allocation.
Withholding closes the supply line and tests whether any alternative provider can reopen it.
The army supplies the body whose effectiveness depends on continuing provision.
Aid as giving lets rescue include maintaining the recipient rather than only winning a clash.

structural_cues: 67:20 and 67:21 use consecutive parallel challenges beginning أمن هذا الذي.
The first asks who helps and the second who provides if provision is withheld.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an army, aid as giving, soldiers' provisions, allocated sustenance, and withholding; I infer that the parallel questions expose logistics as a precondition of rescue. Alternatively, army and provision may be separate examples of dependence rather than one supply mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Rescue means intervention by a fighting force at the moment of danger.
changed_reading.after: Rescue begins upstream as provisioning: the supposed army cannot help when the food, pay, and sustaining allocation that make it operable can be withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later statement of little gratitude selects the 'covering a blessing' branch of كفر. The delusion is maintained by suppressing the giver relation: benefits that enable life and defense are reclassified as the group's own resources, and the group then mistakes possession for independence.

activation_trace.role: Littleness marks gratitude as the deficient response to supplied capacities.
Recognition of a benefit and praise of its giver supplies the relation that the focus unbelief suppresses.
Covering a blessing describes the mechanism by which received support is misregistered as self-produced power.
The resulting self-sufficient appearance is the lure that survives after the giver has been hidden.

structural_cues: 67:23 lists created hearing, sight, and hearts before saying that little thanks is given.
The focus's possessive لكم similarly makes a received capacity sound like an independently owned resource.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies little gratitude, recognition of benefit, covering a blessing, and deceptive appearance; I infer a causal arrow from suppressed gratitude to misattributed security. Alternatively, كفر in the focus can retain its doctrinal sense while ingratitude remains only a correlated symptom.

changed_reading.before: الكافرون names people who reject a claim about divine power.
changed_reading.after: الكافرون also names a support-accounting failure: they hide the giver of their capacities, book received protection as their own asset, and thereby enter غرور.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence moves from asking who can place the unbelievers under protective guarantee to naming al-Rahman and entrusting affairs to Him. This changes the focus from an inventory of weapons to a placement of reliance: the decisive issue is whose custody can actually underwrite protection.

activation_trace.role: Protective neighborhood under guarantee supplies the legal-social form of the rescue being sought.
Merciful beneficence names the party in whom the protective relation is placed.
Reliance supplies the act of entrusting an outcome rather than pretending to own its guarantee.
One who sufficiently keeps an affair supplies the functional counterpart to the failed army.
An other source is the proposed location for misplaced reliance.
Effective aid is the outcome that a genuine custodian must be able to secure.

structural_cues: 67:28 repeats the focus's rescue challenge as فمن يجير الكافرين.
67:29 answers relationally with هو الرحمن آمنا به وعليه توكلنا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective guarantee, al-Rahman, reliance, sufficient custody, and focus aid; I infer that military confidence is one form of misplaced entrustment. Alternatively, توكل may describe the believers' response without defining the exact failure of the focus addressees.

changed_reading.before: The challenge asks which force has enough power to intervene.
changed_reading.after: The challenge asks where the addressees have lodged custody of their outcome, contrasting an unbacked alternative guarantor with reliance on the one able to keep the affair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next comparison spatializes the focus diagnosis. One walker is overturned onto the face while the other is whole and upright on a directed path; reliance on a force 'below/short of' al-Rahman becomes a posture that cannot survey where support comes from or where it leads.

activation_trace.role: Being overturned onto the face gives bodily form to a security judgment that has lost orientation.
Direction and orientation make the contrast about where the walker is headed, not only how the body looks.
Gentle direction to the path supplies the corrective alternative to misoriented reliance.
Wholeness and uprightness supply a stable posture for perceiving and proceeding.
The straight road turns correct reliance into a traversable course.
Straight balance supplies the maintained alignment opposed to falling onto the face.
Lower position and falling short anchor the focus alternative in the spatial mechanism.
Ignorance of the outcome makes the downward orientation hazardous rather than merely mistaken.

structural_cues: 67:22 follows the paired army and provision questions without a topic break in the packet.
The أمن construction in 67:20 is followed by the أفمن ... أمن comparison in 67:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies face-down and upright walking, direction, a straight path, and focus senses of lower position and hazardous outcome; I infer that the bodily contrast renders the earlier reliance as misorientation. Alternatively, 67:22 may contrast guidance generally rather than specifically unpacking the army claim.

changed_reading.before: غرور is an incorrect estimate about who can help.
changed_reading.after: غرور is a lived orientation: dependence is aimed downward at a force that falls short, leaving the person face-down to the route and outcome of support.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a military challenge through water infrastructure. It remains anchored in focus branches where نصر is rain-relief and distant channels feeding collected water, then gains context support from the final question about water sinking and a flowing spring. Downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for life-support, not claim that جند lexically means water.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb ينصركم has branch images of rain as relief and channels bringing distant water, while the focus asks what can function as a helping force.

activation_trace.role: Rain and relief make rescue an ecological arrival that restores a community.
Channels arriving from afar supply a distributed support network feeding a water reserve.
Water itself is the indispensable material whose availability performs life-preserving aid.
Descent into depth removes the support network from human reach.
A flowing spring supplies the concrete return of aid that no claimed army can manufacture.

changed_reading.before: A helper arrives as armed manpower.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the decisive auxiliary can be the hydrological network itself: rain, channels, and an accessible spring whose arrival or withdrawal determines whether the community can endure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because نفور in 67:21 most directly signals aversion, while its inventory also contains mobilization to war or aid and a supporting band. The reversal remains anchored in focus جند and نصر and is reinforced by later gathering to a destination. Downstream prose should mark it as an ironic activation, not replace the surface sense of aversion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a mutually supporting جند to نصر, and the next ayah answers the paired challenge with continued نفور.

activation_trace.role: The mutually supporting host anchors the expected mobilized collective.
Aid supplies the direction in which a genuine supporting band would mobilize.
Rising to war or aid supplies an ironic mobilization inside the surface aversion.
A mobilized supporting band echoes the focus army while reversing its effective direction.
Being driven and gathered to a destination shows collective motion ultimately directed from outside the group.

changed_reading.before: The imagined army is a coalition mobilized toward the addressees' defense.
changed_reading.after: The next ayah permits an ironic counter-image: their collective energy mobilizes as aversion, so the supposed rescue corps moves away from aid and is eventually gathered by another direction.

strongest_changes: The ranked birds immediately before the focus turn visible formation into evidence of dependence: coordinated bodies still require al-Rahman's holding.
The parallel provision question turns military rescue into logistics, sharpened by the branch image of soldiers' provisions.
The later guarantee and trust sequence recasts the challenge as placement of custody, not merely comparison of weapons.
Little gratitude activates كفر as hiding benefaction, so غرور becomes a misaccounting of received support as owned power.
summary.what_was_special: The focus was unusually productive because its military vocabulary is surrounded by maintained flight, reversible terrain, withheld provision, bodily orientation, trust, and inaccessible water. These contexts do not erase the army sense; they expose the layers of holding, supply, custody, and ecology that an apparently autonomous army conceals.
remaining_uncertainties: The stony-ground branch of جند is packet-backed but may function only as wordplay rather than as a genuine material extension in this ayah.
The hydrological reading depends on carrying rain-relief and water-channel branches of نصر to the final water question.
The mobilization reading of نفور is intentionally ironic and should remain secondary to its immediate aversion sense.
The inspection and walking sequences may be surah-level analogies rather than direct explanations of 67:20.
